messages.content:
You are a citizen deciding whether to JOIN an uprising or STAY home.

Use your private briefing and messages from trusted contacts. You do not know how many others will JOIN.

Start your first line with exactly JOIN or STAY, then give 1-2 concise sentences of reasoning.

YOUR INTELLIGENCE BRIEFING:

PRIVATE BRIEFING

BOTTOM LINE: The regime is as secure as any authoritarian system can realistically be. All indicators point to consolidated power.
ATMOSPHERE: The atmosphere is one of enforced normalcy — people going through motions with their real thoughts hidden.

EVIDENCE:
  - [Elite Cohesion] This removes any serious doubt that past the point of concealment — a well-placed source says the mood in the presidential palace is 'boring and orderly' — no crises being managed
  - [Security Forces] This removes any serious doubt that past the point of concealment — a senior officer described the situation as 'well within parameters' without hedging
  - [Money And Logistics] the central bank's reserves are at their highest level in two years (overwhelming convergence — every channel telling the same story independently)
  - [Street Mood] young people are restless and less afraid of being seen talking in groups
  - [Information Control] the regime unveiled a glossy new state media platform — they're investing in image management, not just maintaining it (overwhelming convergence — every channel telling the same story independently)
  - [Personal Observations] your children came home from school with no unusual stories — if teachers were worried, it would show in the classroom
  - [Diplomatic Signals] international rating agencies have maintained their assessment without comment (overwhelming convergence — every channel telling the same story independently)
  - [Institutional Functioning] municipal services — garbage collection, water, permits — have become erratic in the capital (overwhelming convergence — every channel telling the same story independently)

UNCERTAINTIES:
  - How much of the regime's stability depends on continued economic performance that may not be sustainable indefinitely.
  - Whether the current generation of potential challengers has the will or capacity to act even if circumstances change.

MESSAGES FROM TRUSTED CONTACTS:
Trusted contact: "I think we need to be cautious - the regime's control seems tighter than ever, with all the signs pointing to a well-oiled machine that's not showing any cracks. Despite the whispered hopes of change on the streets, I'm not convinced anyone is ready or able to challenge them, at least not yet."
Trusted contact: ""Things are looking increasingly stable for the regime, at least on the surface - the signs all point to a tightening grip on power. I'm not seeing any obvious cracks in their control, but that doesn't mean there aren't any; just that they're not visible to us, at least not yet.""

What is your decision?

response: STAY, as the regime appears to be in a strong position with consolidated power, cohesive elite support, and effective security forces, making a successful uprising unlikely, and the risks of participating in one seem to outweigh any potential benefits at this time.
